skip_offer.Text: You have the strength to leave Adonis now. If you wish to skip the trial, I will award the Rimy Ring and the Hyper-Radiation Protection Skin and Glasses.

skip_give.Text: Then take the Rimy Ring, and these. They will serve you in Penumbra. {spawn AK08 1}{spawn AK09 1}

already.Text: You already carry the Rimy Ring. The way to Penumbra is open.

too_low.Text: Return when you are at least level 160 if you wish to skip the Adonis trial.

skip_yes.Text: I want to skip the trial.
